variants.name: Life Cover
variants.summary: Pure term cover; payout as lump sum, monthly income or a mix; add-ons available

variants.name: Return of Premium
variants.summary: Death cover plus return of all premiums paid if the insured survives the term

eligibility.max_premium_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Max entry age Life Cover: 65 (limited pay 5/7/10/15/20), 55 regular pay, 50 pay-to-60; ROP option: 60 limited pay, 50 pay-to-60 and regular pay. Min maturity age 23 (Life Cover) / 28 (ROP); max term = 100 minus entry age. Min term 10 yrs (5/7-pay), 15 (10-pay), 20 (15-pay), 25 (20-pay), 5 yrs regular-pay Life Cover, 10 yrs regular-pay ROP. Brochure minimum premium by mode: half-yearly 1,536, quarterly 780, monthly 264 (web page shows different figures). Better Half spouse SA 25 lakh to 1 crore; Child's Future Protect SA 10-100% of base SA.

benefits.death: Base sum assured (plus any Child's Future Protect cover) on death in term; ROP option pays at least 105% of premiums paid. Paid as lump sum, monthly income (36 or 60 months) or a lump sum plus income.
benefits.maturity: Life Cover: none. Return of Premium: 100% of total premiums paid (excluding extra premiums and taxes).
benefits.other: Better Half Benefit (spouse cover after insured's death), Child's Future Protect Benefit, Premium Break Benefit (skip up to 8 premiums, PPT 10+ yrs), Special Exit Benefit for limited-pay Life Cover.

term.payout_options: Lump sum / Monthly income / Lump sum + income

key_features: Two options: Life Cover and Return of Premium
Optional Better Half Benefit covers the spouse after the insured's death
Child's Future Protect adds 10-100% extra cover for a child
Premium Break Benefit lets you skip up to 8 premiums
Death payout as lump sum, monthly income or both
products.tax_benefits: Premiums and benefits eligible for tax benefits under prevailing Income Tax law (page cites Income Tax Act, 2025); subject to change.
products.description: Non-linked, non-participating term plan with Life Cover and Return of Premium options plus optional spouse, child and premium-break add-ons, for people wanting high-value protection.

products.name: Guaranteed Flexi STAR

variants.name: Lumpsum
variants.summary: Sum assured on maturity plus accrued guaranteed additions paid at the end of the term

variants.name: Lumpsum with Income
variants.summary: Guaranteed annual income after the premium-paying term plus a maturity lump sum; income can be preponed

eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Page states entry age 0 to 70 for the policyholder; life-assured maximum not confirmed. Lumpsum option term 10-40 yrs (PPT 5-8) or 15-40 (PPT 9-12); Lumpsum with Income terms are PPT-specific (19-43). Min SA 168,000 for ages 0-49, 120,000 for 50+.

benefits.death: Life cover as a multiple of annualised premium (page says 10x; FAQ says 5x/7x/10x depending on PPT and entry age).
benefits.maturity: Lumpsum: sum assured on maturity plus accrued guaranteed additions. Lumpsum with Income: final income instalment plus sum assured on maturity (higher of 10x or PPT x annualised premium).
benefits.survival_income: Lumpsum with Income option pays guaranteed annual income from the 2nd policy year after PPT; can be preponed to start from year 1 up to PPT+1.

products.tax_benefits: Tax benefits as per prevailing Income Tax law (page cites Income Tax Act, 2025); subject to change.

products.name: Assured Income STAR

variants.name: Regular Income
variants.summary: Guaranteed income from policy year 1 plus maturity lump sum and life cover

variants.name: Regular Income Advantage
variants.summary: Pays 40% or 50% of annualised premium upfront in year 1, then regular income from year 2, plus maturity lump sum

eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Min SA 150,000 for entry age 50+ and 210,000 for ages 0-49. Terms: Regular Income 20/25/30/35/40 yrs; Regular Income Advantage 25/30/35/40 yrs (annual mode only). Term 20 not available for PPT 5/6/7 under death option 2. Life cover 7x (age under 50) or 5x (50+) annualised premium under option 1, 10x under option 2.

benefits.death: Sum assured to the nominee on death in term; cover is 7x/5x annualised premium (option 1) or 10x (option 2).
benefits.maturity: Lump sum maturity benefit if the life assured survives the term and the policy is in force.
benefits.survival_income: Guaranteed income paid annually in arrears from year 1 until maturity or death, can be taken monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly.
benefits.other: Income can be accrued instead of paid out; guarantees apply only if all due premiums are paid. Free look 30 days.

savings.income_duration: Annual from policy year 1 until maturity or death

key_features: Guaranteed regular income plus lump sum at maturity
Regular Income or Regular Income Advantage (upfront payout) options
Income payout monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly
Policy loan after surrender value is acquired
products.tax_benefits: Premiums may qualify under Section 80C and benefits under Section 10(10D) (page cites Income Tax Act, 2025); subject to change.
products.description: Non-linked, non-participating savings plan paying guaranteed income from the first policy year (with an upfront-payout variant) plus a maturity lump sum and life cover, for people wanting steady cash flow.

products.name: Premier Guaranteed STAR

eligibility.max_sum_assured_text: No limit, subject to board-approved underwriting policy
eligibility.notes: Terms by PPT: 5-pay 22/27/32/37; 8-pay 20/25/30/35/40; 10-pay 22/27/32/37/42; 12-pay 24/29/34/39/44 yrs. Page shows monthly premium from Rs 4,400 but no annual minimum.

benefits.death: Life cover of at least 10x annualised premium throughout the term while the policy is in force.
benefits.maturity: If the lump sum option is chosen at inception: sum assured on maturity (higher of 10 or PPT times annualised premium) with the last income; otherwise none.
benefits.survival_income: Income starts from the 3rd policy year after PPT and continues to maturity or death; payout is a percentage of annualised premium and rises 5% every 5 policy years.
benefits.other: Suicide within 12 months pays at least 80% of premiums paid or surrender value if higher. Free look 30 days.

key_features: Guaranteed income that steps up every 5 policy years
Choice of 5, 8, 10 or 12 year premium-paying term
Optional lump sum at maturity (chosen only at inception)
Life cover of at least 10x annualised premium
Policy loan after surrender value builds
products.tax_benefits: Premiums under Section 80C and income/maturity under Section 10(10D) (page cites Income Tax Act, 2025); subject to change.
